name: litellm-cost-tpm
description: Test 3 on LiteLLM v1.103.2: a token-per-minute limit. Run with the t3-tpm key (tpm_limit 1000; README.md). LiteLLM reserves input plus max_completion_tokens (256) before each call and settles to actual use after it, so one at a time about 7 requests fit (~110 tokens each, and the next needs a full ~300-token reservation free), at once only about 3 (~300 reserved each), and a request whose cap alone exceeds the limit is refused without a call. Cases without a status expectation are read from their status mix.
